summary.text: John Rogers is a Democratic state representative from the 12th Norfolk District who has held the seat since 1993 and is on the ballot for re-election on November 3, 2026. He is an attorney.

paragraphs.text: John Rogers earned a bachelor's degree from Brandeis University and a law degree from Suffolk University Law School in 1992, and Ballotpedia lists his profession as attorney.

In the 2025-2026 session his committee assignments include the House Post Audit and Oversight Committee and the Community Development and Small Businesses Joint Committee, and he is vice chair of the Joint Committee on Bonding, Capital Expenditures, and State Assets.
